origin: Original user-directed built-in image generation, security-room-menu-v1; not taken from another mod.
note: Generated art has incidental partial alpha outside screen holes. An opaque black underlay prevents vanilla background bleed. Rounded apertures mask the animated textures.
animation: Eight deterministic original grayscale 64x48 textures authored by scripts/generate_menu_static.py; Lua owns independent timing.

ultrawide.layout: User-selected continuous room with one straight horizontal pipe extended across the left wall at its existing height. Desk and four CRTs retain the selected composition; uniform top-aligned cover scaling focuses standard viewports on menu/desk and reveals right decoration on ultrawide displays.
ultrawide.origin: User-supplied owned panorama edited with built-in image generation to complete only the missing left horizontal pipe. User explicitly selected this output for application/publication. PNG used unchanged. Prompt and SHA: MENU_SELECTED_PIPE_PROMPT.md. Earlier redraws remain historical.
ultrawide.decoration: Small far-left vent and low footlocker; quiet left menu wall. Desk with four CRTs, keyboard, mug, papers and radio. Right filing cabinets, archive boxes, noticeboard, keys, telephone and extinguisher, all regenerated together.

menu_wall.note: Lua lays out dynamic menu entries inside this clear wall; these are internal image coordinates.
